en.title: Before buying an integrated cockpit: fit, service and the hidden extras
en.description: Questions to ask about bar dimensions, frame interfaces, hose routing, adjustment and replacement parts before ordering an integrated cockpit.
en.intro: An integrated cockpit can make a bike look wonderfully tidy. It can also turn a small fit change into a parts hunt. Decide how you want to sit on the bike before deciding how few cables you want to see.

sections.heading: Choose your position before your silhouette
paragraphs: Start with the contact points that work for you. Confirm the proposed bar width, reach and drop, stem length and angle, and how the manufacturer measures them. Two cockpits carrying the same width label may still feel different.

Have a fitter or experienced assembler compare the complete setup with your target position. Frame reach alone cannot describe where the hoods end up. Ask which alternative cockpit sizes are actually available if the first choice does not work.
Do this before a custom frame order or steerer cut. A discount on the wrong cockpit can disappear quickly when replacement parts and workshop labor enter the calculation.

sections.heading: Treat the cockpit as part of a system
paragraphs: Ask the frame seller for the exact approved combination of cockpit, headset cover, spacers and other front-end hardware. Obtain the current assembly manual, such as the model-specific information available through [Tavelo’s downloads](https://tavelo.cc/download/), rather than relying on visual similarity.

Confirm permitted adjustment ranges and how the system routes hoses or cables. A spacer from a different frame that appears to fit may not be an approved replacement. Keep unanswered interface questions open until the manufacturer or assembler resolves them.
Also ask about accessory mounts. A computer and light need a suitable mounting arrangement, and its hardware should be included in the cost and parts list rather than improvised on delivery day.

sections.heading: Ask the mechanic what a future change involves
paragraphs: Show the workshop the exact routing diagram and ask what replacing the cockpit or servicing the headset would involve on this model. Depending on the layout, a change can require more work than loosening a conventional stem.

Get a realistic assembly and service estimate, including any consumables the actual system needs. This is a planning question, not a reason to dismiss every integrated design. Some riders value the appearance enough to accept the maintenance arrangement.
Ask how proprietary covers, spacers and fasteners can be ordered later. A frame’s warranty duration does not establish how quickly an individual small part will arrive.

sections.heading: Use a four-question purchase test
paragraphs: Can the available cockpit reach your position within the manual’s limits? Does the quoted package include every required interface part? Will your workshop build and service it? Can you obtain the proprietary spares?

If those answers are clear, compare the complete price with the alternatives the frame manufacturer permits. If one is unresolved, keep investigating before approving the frame order. The cleanest-looking cockpit is most enjoyable when it does not make the rest of ownership complicated.
Write the chosen dimensions and approved parts on the invoice. Your future self, holding a replacement spacer and trying to remember which version you bought, will appreciate the boring detail.

zh-Hans.title: 购买一体把之前：合身、维护与容易漏掉的配件
zh-Hans.description: 订购一体把前，问清把组尺寸、车架接口、油管走线、调整范围和替换件，避免装好后才发现问题。
zh-Hans.intro: 一体把能让车头很整洁，也可能把一次小合身调整变成找配件任务。先决定自己怎样坐在车上，再决定希望看见几根线。

sections.heading: 先选姿势，再选轮廓
paragraphs: 从适合自己的接触点开始，确认把宽、前伸、落差、把立长度角度，以及厂家的测量方式。同样把宽标签，实际感受仍可能不同。
请 fitter 或有经验的装配者把完整设置与目标姿势比较。车架 reach 不能独自决定手变位置。还要问首选不适合时，真正能买到哪些替代尺寸。
应在定制车架下单或截前叉舵管之前完成。错误把组的折扣，可能很快被替换件和工时吃掉。

sections.heading: 把把组视为系统的一部分
paragraphs: 请车架卖家明确允许的把组、碗组上盖、垫圈及前端硬件组合。取得当前装配手册，例如 [Tavelo 下载资料](https://tavelo.cc/download/)中的对应信息，别靠外形相似判断。
确认允许调整范围及油管、线缆走法。别的车架垫圈看似装得上，不代表是认可替代品。接口问题应保留到厂家或装配者明确答复。
还要问附件支架。码表和车灯需要合适安装方案，紧固件也应加入预算和清单，别等到货再临时拼凑。

sections.heading: 问技师日后调整需要做什么
paragraphs: 把准确走线图给车店，问这款车更换把组或维护碗组需做什么。根据布局，可能不只是像普通把立那样松开螺丝。
取得实际装配及维护估计，包含该系统需要的耗材。这是规划问题，不是反对所有一体设计。有人愿意为外观接受维护安排，关键是事先知道。
问日后如何买专用上盖、垫圈和紧固件。车架保修年限不能证明某个小零件多快能到。

sections.heading: 用四个问题检查购买决定
paragraphs: 现有把组能否在手册限制内达到目标姿势？报价是否包含必需接口件？车店是否愿意装配和维护？专用备件能否买到？
四项明确后，再与厂家允许的其他方案比较完整价格。有一项未知，就在确认车架订单前继续查清。整洁前端最好也有清楚的后续使用安排。
发票写明尺寸及认可部件。未来拿着替换垫圈、努力回忆自己买了哪版的你，会感谢这些无聊细节。
